implemented_semantics.authorization: LKH remains the authorization mechanism for the protected rekey material.
implemented_semantics.ranger_payload: RANGER transports an opaque authenticated/encrypted rekey capsule.
implemented_semantics.authorized_acceptance: Only currently authorized members may accept a reconstructed capsule and advance to the rekey epoch.
implemented_semantics.revocation: Revoked members may observe or relay network traffic but must not accept the new group epoch.
implemented_semantics.recovery_request: Recovery requests are issued for stale authorized targets.
implemented_semantics.recovery_request_validation: Requester identity, group, epoch, authorization and capsule identity are checked before a recovery response is generated.
implemented_semantics.recovery_helper: The Group Manager or an authorized neighbor may provide available fragments.

formal_abstractions.lkh_tree: Collapsed into a survivor authorization wrapping secret. This models the authorization boundary, not the exact binary LKH key-update graph.
formal_abstractions.coded_fragments: The cryptographically protected rekey capsule is modeled as one symbolic protected object. Threshold Reed-Solomon algebra is outside this Tamarin model and was validated separately in STEP7C.
formal_abstractions.network: Dolev-Yao adversary controls delivery, replay and reordering through Tamarin In/Out facts.
formal_abstractions.topology_and_loss: Not modeled symbolically; evaluated experimentally in STEP7A/STEP7B/STEP7C.
formal_abstractions.epoch_scope: Each modeled rekey event has a fresh symbolic epoch. Global latest-epoch ordering across multiple sequential rekeys is not claimed in STEP7D1.

explicit_compromise_model.authorized_member_compromise: The adversary may reveal the shared survivor authorization secret through compromise of an authorized member.
explicit_compromise_model.manager_compromise: The adversary may reveal the survivor authorization secret through Group Manager compromise.
explicit_compromise_model.secrecy_claim: Epoch-key secrecy is required only unless one of those relevant authorization secrets is compromised before adversary knowledge.

not_claimed: Formal equivalence between Python, C, Cooja and Tamarin
